submission_method.value: Email to CMHC's electronic bid submission system (EBID) at EBID@cmhc-schl.gc.ca; 10MB size limit, may split across multiple emails; technical proposal (PDF) must be a separate file from the pricing proposal (Appendix B).

contract_term.quote: The term of the agreement resulting from this RFP is to be for a period of one (1) year, with options to extend the agreement on the same terms and conditions for four (4) additional 1-year renewal periods for a total term not to exceed five (5) years collectively.
contract_term.value: 1-year initial term + up to four 1-year renewal options, 5 years total maximum

scope_of_deliverables.quote: CMHC is seeking qualified companies through this Request for Proposal (RFP) to confirm and implement an operating model for data management capabilities, specifically Reference Data Management (RDM).
scope_of_deliverables.value: Reference Data Management (RDM) services across three streams: (1) develop/implement an RDM operating model, (2) adopt RDM governance and policy, (3) implement a sustainable technical solution - leveraging CMHC's existing Informatica IDMC, Collibra, and Azure deployment.

pricing_structure.quote:
Pricing is worth 20 points of the total score. 
Pricing will be scored based on a relative pricing formula using the rates set out in the Pricing Form. Each proponent will receive a percentage of the total possible points allocated to price for the particular category it has bid on, which will be calculated in accordance with the following formula: 
 
Lowest price ÷ proponent's price x weighting = proponent's pricing points
pricing_structure.value: Pricing worth 20 of 100 points, scored via formula: (lowest price / proponent's price) x weighting = pricing points. Rates quoted in CAD, exclusive of taxes, must be all-inclusive (labour, materials, travel, insurance, installation, overhead). Submitted as a separate document/file from the technical proposal.

insurance_requirements.quote: Commercial General Liability insurance with an insurer licensed to do business in Canada with a limit of not less than five million dollars ($5,000,000) inclusive for personal injury, bodily injury (including death) and property damage for any one occurrence or series of occurrences arising from one cause.

references_required.quote: R.4: Provide three client references from similar engagements in the past 5 years. Same references can be used from R.1.1
references_required.raw: R.1.1 requires at least 2 public-sector client references; R.4 separately requires 3 references from similar engagements in the past 5 years, explicitly allowing reuse of the R.1.1 references. Recorded 3 as the larger, more specific, binding count.

data_hosting_residency.value: CMHC Data must remain within Canada at all times, at rest and in transit, and be accessed only from within Canada (or a country with a bilateral security agreement with Canada, for remote work location purposes).

vendor_demonstration_required.quote: The proponent will bear all costs associated with or incurred in the preparation and presentation of its proposal, including, if applicable, costs incurred for interviews or demonstrations.
vendor_demonstration_required.raw: Conditional/discretionary language only ("if applicable") - no dedicated demonstration stage is described anywhere in the evaluation process (Section 2.1/2.2), unlike RFPs with an explicit scored demo stage.
